0022600210.text: The Golden State Warriors host the New Orleans Pelicans in the Warriors' 11th game of the season. Golden State (7-3, 5-1 at home) is on a seven-game winning streak, sits 2nd in the Pacific 1.5 games back and 5th in the West, while New Orleans (4-5, 1-2 on the road) has lost its last game, sits 5th in the Southwest 3.5 games back, and is 11th in the West. Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Will Richard (thumb), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision, while New Orleans is without Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, though their most recent meeting was a 113-109 loss in New Orleans on February 24, 2026.
